Sleep was a nightmare for me once. Not the kind where you wake up scared.
The kind where you're scared to fall asleep. This is what happened. And what I learned. I don't know what triggered it. I was just... tense. Worried about nothing specific. Managing large codebases is challenging. Finding what to refactor first, tracking technical debt, and maintaining context across long coding sessions can be overwhelming.
